title: PortBay config-as-code (portbay.yml)
description: In-repo project descriptor PortBay reads from a project root. Commit it so teammates can reproduce the local environment. Secrets are listed by name only and never stored here.

version.description: Schema version. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

type.description: How PortBay launches the project (its kind).

framework.description: Optional sub-stack override (brand logo/label only). Re-detected from the folder when omitted.

hostname.description: Full local hostname Caddy routes to the project (e.g. blog.test).

https.description: Whether Caddy terminates local TLS for the hostname.

ssl_mode.description: Certificate source for the HTTPS edge.

runtime.description: Pinned language runtime. Omit to inherit the language default at add time.

lang.description: Language id (php, node, python, go, ruby, …).

start_command.description: Shell command run inside the project path to launch the dev server.

document_root.description: PHP document root relative to the project path (e.g. public).

port.description: Primary HTTP port the dev server binds to.

env.description: Non-secret environment variables. Values may use ${PROJECT_PATH} / ${PROJECT_NAME} placeholders.

secrets.description: Names (only) of env vars that are secrets. PortBay prompts for their values on import; they are never committed here.

databases.description: Databases the project needs. PortBay provisions each against a running instance of its engine.

name.description: Database / schema name to provision (e.g. blog_dev).

groups.description: Names of groups this project belongs to. Groups are created on import if they don't exist.

auto_start.description: Start this project automatically when the PortBay daemon comes up.

pre_start.description: Shell commands run before the dev server on each start (deps install, DB migrate).

post_start.description: Shell commands run after the dev server reports ready (health checks, warm-up).
